# Youkeo Studios

> Professional recording studio in Airoli, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
> Founded by Nischay Beharam (artist aliases: Shoonya & Rhyo), music producer with 13+ years experience and 1M+ Spotify streams.

Youkeo Studios is a full-service music studio offering vocal recording, instrument recording, music production, mixing, mastering, and music distribution for independent artists, bands, and brands. Located in Sector-19, Airoli, Navi Mumbai — 8 minutes from Airoli Railway Station. 200+ artists recorded. 5-star rated.

## Services

- **Vocal & Instrument Recording**: ₹1,200/hr (engineer included)
- **Music Production**: Beat, arrangement & production for ₹12,000/song (standalone)
- **Mixing & Mastering**: Stereo Mix & Master starts at ₹5,000; Stem Mix & Master starts at ₹12,000
- **Mastering Only (Master & Polish)**: ₹2,000/track
- **Recording to Final Package**: ₹14,000/song (includes 2 hrs recording + mix & master)
- **Production to Final Package**: ₹26,000/song (includes beat production + 2 hrs recording + mix & master)
- **Release & Promotion**: Distribution, playlist pitching & paid promotion (included as a consultation in the Production to Final bundle)
